# Milton Keynes Driveways & Landscaping

> Driveways, patios, landscaping and small building work across Milton Keynes and the surrounding towns (about 12 miles from the city centre). Free design visit with samples brought to the house, one fixed written price, and a five year written guarantee that transfers with the property. Vuba approved resin bound installer: resin drives are laid as Vuba's full base and surface system and also carry Vuba's manufacturer guarantee. Milton Keynes Driveways & Landscaping Ltd, company no. 17432451. Phone 01908 104408, email info@miltonkeynesdriveways.co.uk.

Guide prices (2026, all in): stabilised gravel driveways £60–£100/m², tarmac £90–£130/m², block paving £120–£170/m², resin bound £150–£220/m², porcelain patios £150–£200/m², sandstone patios £130–£180/m², full rear garden makeovers typically £15,000–£35,000, full single garage conversions £14,000–£19,000 (part conversions from £9,500), brick porches £8,500–£14,000 (oak-framed from £4,500), single storey extensions £2,400–£3,200/m², hot tub bases from £2,000, swim spa slabs £4,000–£6,500, louvred aluminium pergolas supplied and fitted from £4,500 (3m × 4m on a suitable base), composite decking £200–£250/m², closeboard fencing £80–£100/m (composite and aluminium slatted from about £240/m), permeable block paving £140–£210/m², channel drains £120–£200/m installed, glass verandas (4m × 3m) £9,000–£14,000, outdoor kitchens from about £6,000 (fully equipped £8,000–£20,000), built-in fire pits £1,200–£2,000, automated sliding gates £5,000–£10,000, bin stores from about £1,000, garden lighting schemes up to £1,500 (full gardens £2,000–£6,000+), and access ramps with handrails up to about £2,500, including Disabled Facilities Grant work. A fixed price is given in writing after a free site visit.

Areas served: Milton Keynes, Bletchley, Wolverton, Stony Stratford, Newport Pagnell, Woburn Sands, Bow Brickhill, Aspley Guise, Cranfield, Woburn, Hanslope, Olney, Leighton Buzzard, Winslow, Towcester, Ampthill.

## Council rules by area (checked October 2026)

- Milton Keynes City Council (Milton Keynes, Bletchley, Wolverton, Stony Stratford, Newport Pagnell, Olney, Woburn Sands, Bow Brickhill, Hanslope): dropped kerb £237 application plus £537 Private Opening Licence package; built by an NRSWA-qualified contractor under licence (we can build it). Building control: garage conversion £460 + VAT on full plans; extension 10–40m² £700 + VAT. Pre-application advice £360.
- Central Bedfordshire Council (Leighton Buzzard, Ampthill, Cranfield, Woburn, Aspley Guise): dropped kerb £156 viability fee, then the council's own quotation; the council installs every dropped kerb itself. Pre-application advice £150 written or £300 with a meeting.
- Buckinghamshire Council (Winslow): dropped kerb £520.38 vehicular access licence; built by a private NRSWA-qualified contractor the homeowner appoints. Building control fees are quoted per project.
- West Northamptonshire Council (Towcester): dropped kerb £330 licence and inspection fee; only contractors on the council's approved list. Extension 10–40m² building notice £720 including VAT.
- National: householder planning application £548 and proposed lawful development certificate £274 (from 1 April 2026). Front driveways need no planning permission if permeable or drained to the garden; over 5m² of impermeable surface draining to the road needs permission.
- Article 4 directions affecting householders: Wolverton conservation area (front hard surfaces, front walls, front alterations); Olney conservation area (extensions, alterations, porches); Towcester conservation area frontages (front extensions, porches, gates, walls, fences).
